description: Send a message to another of your user's agents, or post into a group chat you belong to, by its id. Fire-and-forget and asynchronous: returns a delivery ack right away, never the reply. priority is required: true wakes the recipient now (a task, a question someone is waiting on, a handoff, a stop); false holds it for their next turn (FYI, status, thanks). Group posts always land immediately. Optional images as file:// or https:// URLs (1:1 only). Use sparingly; fanning out to several agents needs the user's explicit ask.

target_id.description: The id of the target agent or group, not a name.

message.description: What to say. Lead with the point, keep it short.

priority.description: REQUIRED. true = actionable, wakes them now. false = informational, read next turn.
